comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Recovery implementation and validation complete. Retryable report-publication/auth interruptions now keep the active Task/attempt running; checkpoint corruption fails closed after attachment-backed verification. Focused suite: 99 passed; optimization suite: 133 passed; diff check clean. Escalation: Report and Task update APIs accept only unconstrained field updates (no conditional version/claim primitive), so concurrent publication cannot be made atomic without schema/resource/API support; no weak lock was added.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Corrective implementation started after independent review. Adding outside-in coverage for existing-attempt frozen identity, terminal update replay, and retryable initialization/finalization. Concurrent revision publication remains single-authority because current model updates expose no atomic conditional commit; a backend conditional-commit capability is required before multi-writer support.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Corrective review findings addressed. Existing attempts now require exact frozen run specifications in both Task and Report metadata before recovery; finalization replay republishes the idempotent terminal update; initialization and finalization transport/auth interruptions remain active and replayable while verified integrity corruption remains terminal. Validation: 109 focused tests passed, 143 optimization tests passed, and diff check is clean. Concurrent publication remains a documented single-authority limitation pending an atomic conditional revision commit API.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Remaining recovery exception-classification finding corrected. Authorized attachment ticket, authorization, and transfer interruptions are retryable and leave the active attempt running; a subsequent successful read replays the committed checkpoint without repeating analysis. Artifact integrity, malformed content, descriptor/checksum, milestone, and frozen-identity corruption remain terminal. Validation: 120 focused/client tests passed, 154 optimization tests passed, and diff check is clean.
